   from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
   import numpy as np
   
   def sigmoid(alpha, k, alpha_c, y_max):
       return y_max / (1 + np.exp(-k * (alpha - alpha_c)))

   ```

   PermG_rate_T20(α) = Φ(z_T20(α))
   predicted_count_T20(α) = round(8 × PermG_rate_T20(α))
   ```
